source_repository.policy: Transfer mathematical meaning and traceability; do not duplicate Pytyliki runtime implementation.

target.compatibility: No change to base K3 semantics; imported models are typed extensions.

status_legend.implemented_numeric_contract: Corresponding C11 implementation/source contract exists; this does not claim that CI was executed during transfer.
status_legend.documented_contract: Behavior is documented but full runtime path is not asserted.
status_legend.proposed_extension: Candidate or future operation, not an implemented public capability.
status_legend.classical_simulation: Bounded classical numerical model, not physical quantum hardware.
status_legend.migrated_out: Implementation ownership moved to another repository; do not duplicate code.
status_legend.abstraction_only: Mathematical model of an engineering domain; proof of runtime enforcement is separate.

mathematical_domains.title: Евклидова арифметика
mathematical_domains.model: a=q*b+r; 0<=r<abs(b), b!=0
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Exact integers map to canonical radix-1000 vectors; remainders under division by 1000 are K3 coefficients.
mathematical_domains.limits: Zero divisor and INT64_MIN/-1 rejected; finite int64 domain.

mathematical_domains.title: Сбалансированное разбиение
mathematical_domains.model: q=floor(n/p), r=n-p*q; lengths_i=q+1 if i<r else q
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counts, ranges, indexes and lengths are separate K3 integers.
mathematical_domains.limits: Planning does not imply worker execution.

mathematical_domains.title: Равномерное распределение целого итога
mathematical_domains.model: A=abs(T); q=A div p; r=A mod p; x_i=sign(T)*(q+indicator(i<r))
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Signed shares map as sign and K3 magnitude.
mathematical_domains.limits: p>0; bounded output capacity.

mathematical_domains.title: Взвешенное распределение методом наибольших остатков
mathematical_domains.model: quota_i=T*w_i/W; base_i=floor(quota_i); residue_i=(T*w_i) mod W; assign leftover by descending residue and stable index
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Total, weights, quotas, residues and shares are K3 integers; preserve indexes.
mathematical_domains.limits: Positive weight sum; bounded recipient count.

mathematical_domains.title: Биномиальные коэффициенты
mathematical_domains.model: C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n-k)!); symmetry and gcd cancellation
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: n, k and exact result map to K3 integers.
mathematical_domains.limits: n<=1000000; result must fit uint64_t.

mathematical_domains.title: Жадный выбор ограниченного набора
mathematical_domains.model: Sort by preference_i/price_i via cross multiplication; take min(stock_i,floor(remaining/price_i))
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Prices, stocks, budget and spent amount map to K3 integers.
mathematical_domains.limits: Heuristic, not globally optimal knapsack.

mathematical_domains.title: Векторные нормы, расстояния и проекции
mathematical_domains.model: L1, L2, L-infinity, dot, weighted norms, projections and orthogonal components
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Coordinates stay typed and indexed; only declared quantization yields integer K3 components.
invariants: Norm and distance axioms in valid exact domains
mathematical_domains.limits: Floating approximation; max dimension 4096; weighted norm requires positive weights to be a norm.

mathematical_domains.title: Квадратичные формы и неевклидовы модели
mathematical_domains.model: Q(x)=x^T M x; spherical, hyperbolic, law-of-cosines, De Gua and Minkowski formulas
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Preserve geometry kind, matrix axes, scale and numerical error.
mathematical_domains.limits: Quadratic form is not automatically a metric; Minkowski form is indefinite.

mathematical_domains.title: Статистика и квантили
mathematical_domains.model: Mean, median, nearest-rank p90/p95/p99, sample standard deviation, coefficient of variation, MAD
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counts are exact K3 integers; floating summaries require scale and uncertainty.
mathematical_domains.limits: 1..100000 finite nonnegative samples; not hardware certification.

mathematical_domains.title: Комплексный state-vector
mathematical_domains.model: psi in C^(2^q), sum(|alpha_j|^2)=1; seeded state-vector measurement
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Real and imaginary parts are separate approximate fields; counts and seeds are separate exact values.
mathematical_domains.limits: q<=10; 133 IDs do not mean 133 implemented solvers; not quantum hardware.

mathematical_domains.title: Ограниченные представления памяти
mathematical_domains.model: (count-1)*stride+element_size<=extent for nonempty views
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counts, sizes, offsets and capacities map to K3 integers; pointers/types remain distinct.
mathematical_domains.limits: Pointers are not K3 positional values.

mathematical_domains.title: Транзакционный автомат снимков
mathematical_domains.model: Commit requires expected_generation=current_generation and valid checksum; generation increments on success
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Generations, schema versions and lengths map to K3 integers; payload stays a byte sequence.
mathematical_domains.limits: In-memory snapshots only; max payload 16 MiB; async/await cooperative.

mathematical_domains.title: Измерительная запись и неопределённость
mathematical_domains.model: record=(metric,unit,context,digest,value,uncertainty,window,count,quality); envelopes disjoint if abs(delta)>eps1+eps2
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counters and timestamps exact; measured values scaled/approximate and carry uncertainty.
mathematical_domains.limits: Not a universal statistical significance test.

mathematical_domains.title: Периодичность и дрейф
mathematical_domains.model: CV, relative bias, first-half/second-half drift; bounded descriptive cadence score
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counts and timestamps map to K3 integers; intervals/scores remain approximations.
mathematical_domains.limits: 2..1000000 intervals; not hardware certification.

mathematical_domains.title: Формальные языки и разбор директив
mathematical_domains.model: Partial parser P: Sigma* -> AST with bounded input and diagnostics
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Offsets and lengths map to K3 integers; symbols and aliases stay typed.
mathematical_domains.limits: Syntax only; max input 512; no execution.

mathematical_domains.title: Кандидатные операции ранней математики
mathematical_domains.model: Counts, histograms, fractions, units, geometry, patterns and simple stats
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Exact counts/fractions use K3 integers and rational pairs; geometry may be approximate.
mathematical_domains.limits: No new public C ABI function claimed implemented.

mathematical_domains.title: Аудио-DSP
mathematical_domains.model: PCM16 WAV, filtering, compression and measurement algorithms
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Kaskad records formulae and provenance only; implementation remains in VentuSample.
mathematical_domains.limits: Do not duplicate DSP code.

mathematical_domains.title: Процессорные и аппаратные модели
mathematical_domains.model: Finite feature sets, typed ranges, capability predicates and evidence metadata
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counts and bounds map to K3 integers; architecture identities and capability sets remain typed.
mathematical_domains.limits: Read-only or simulated paths are not physical device control.

mathematical_domains.title: Политики, эволюция и pipeline
mathematical_domains.model: Finite predicates, dependency graphs, versioned contracts, labeled transition systems
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Counters, versions and indexes map to K3 integers; graph/predicate labels remain explicit.
mathematical_domains.limits: Do not infer runtime enforcement from metadata alone.

mathematical_domains.title: QCS, syntax inspection and diagnostics
mathematical_domains.model: Source string to AST/diagnostics with spans and bounded offsets
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Offsets and lengths map to K3 integers; syntax and spans remain structured.
invariants: inspected source is not necessarily executed.
mathematical_domains.limits: Do not duplicate Reaper grammar or canonical IR.

mathematical_domains.title: Бюджеты и ограниченное планирование
mathematical_domains.model: Bounded integer budget, resource envelopes and exact accounting
mathematical_domains.k3_mapping: Each amount, cap, quantity and balance is an independent K3 integer.
mathematical_domains.limits: Do not infer optimal scheduling without proof.

non_math_and_external_boundaries.reason: Presentation and interaction; include only explicit UI states or measurable constraints.
Implementation is owned by VentuSample; Kaskad does not duplicate it.
Reaper grammar and canonical compiler IR remain owned by Reaper.
Tests are regression evidence, not mathematical proof by themselves.

verification_note: Repository documentation, CMake module list, key mathematical source modules and test-target declarations were inspected. CI and the full CTest suite were not executed during this transfer.
compatibility_rules: Keep radix B=1000 and coefficient set 0..999 unchanged.
Preserve every K3 position, zero coefficient, separator and index.
Keep exact integer arithmetic distinct from floating-point approximation.
Keep vectors, matrices, tensors, complex states, graphs and automata typed.
Do not reinterpret v_1000 as a multiplicative p-adic valuation.
Do not describe the Pytyliki state-vector kernel as quantum hardware.
Do not duplicate audio DSP now owned by VentuSample.
Treat source contracts, catalogues, tests and executed proof evidence as distinct evidence classes.
